text: welcome to the My Son Sanctuary a perfect day trip outside of Hoi An Vietnam in this video we're going to give you some background information and some tips on how to visit located approximately 40 km Southwest of Hoi An Vietnam My Son Sanctuary is an archaeological site of immense cultural significance built by the Champa civilization between the 4th and the 14th century My Son served as a religious Center dedicated to the worship of Hindu gods particularly Shiva the Champa Kingdom which once ruled over Central and Southern Vietnam established My Son as its spiritual and political Capital over several centuries the Champa rulers commissioned the construction of majestic temples and religious monuments within the sanctuary each adorned with intricate carvings and elaborate architecture features My Son's Prosperity was short-lived in the 14th century the Champa Kingdom began to decline due to internal strife and external pressures from neighboring Powers the sanctuary fell into disuse and was eventually abandoned leaving its magnificent temples to be reclaimed by the surrounding jungle Shiva one of the principal gods in Hinduism holds a central place in the religious beliefs and practices of the Champa people as the God of destruction and transformation Shiva is referred as the Supreme Being who presides over creation preservation and destruction at My Son Temple devotees offered prayers and performed rituals to honor Shiva and His blessings for Prosperity protection and spiritual enlightenment the temples of My Son are renowned for their Exquisite architecture and intricate Stone carvings which reflect the artistic and Architectural powers of the Champa civilization built using fired brick and Sandstone the temples feature distinctive red colored bricks and elaborate decorative motives including images of Gods Celestial beings and mythical creatures the temples of My Son Sanctuary stand as enduring Testament to the Ingenuity and craftsmanship of the charm people who employed Innovative building techniques to construct these magnificent structures without the use of modern cement instead the Cham Artisans turned to Nature harnessing the adhesive powers of a substance derived from the local trees to bind the bricks together also known as tree sap glue] in addition to exploring the ancient ruins of My Son Temple visitors have the opportunity to witness traditional Cham dance performances held within the sanctuary these mesmerizing performances showcase the cultural heritage and artistic traditions of the charm people who are descendants of the Champa civilization Cham dance characterized by graceful movement and vibrant costumes is an integral part of Cham religious rituals and ceremonies each dance performance tells a story from Cham mythology and folklore conveying themes of Love devotion and spiritual enlightenment Cham dancers evoke the spirit of ancient rituals and bring to life the myths and legends of the Champa civilization Travelers visiting Hoi An can embark on a halfday Excursion to My Son Temple to explore its surroundings and ancient ruins and immerse themselves in Vietnam's Rich cultural heritage guided tours offer insights into the history and significance of the site allowing visitors to appreciate the architectural Marvels and spiritual significance of My Son to reach My Son Temple from Hoi An Travelers can arrange transportation through local tour operators or hire a private car or a motorbike taxi the journey takes approximately 1 hour by Road passing through Scenic Countryside and Rural Villages along the way another tip visit early in the morning because after 10:00 AM it will be very very crowded you can also opt to go later on in the day around 2:00 p.m. then most of the crowds will already head back to their tour bus but make sure to not come too late because My Son Sanctuary closes at the end of the afternoon early evening a visit to My Son Temple offers a glimpse into Vietnam's ancient past and enduring Legacy of the Champa civilization admidst tranquil settings of The sanctury Travelers can connect with the spiritual energy of this sacred site and
